edits.before: Luden's spike: QE-stun into full rotation deletes squishies. Force the wave contact trades he cannot refuse.
edits.after: His Eclipse-timing all-in outpaces one Zhonya's — play strictly around Death Mark's cooldown and farm; the flip comes at two items.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Scatter the Weak has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Death Mark: 120/110/100s, and the mark detonates 3s after it lands — spend Zhonya's or E AFTER the untargetable dash ends, never before. When it whiffs he is spell-less for two minutes. - Living Shadow: 20s at rank 1 — a Zed with W down cannot trade or escape; that is your poke window. - Your E is 15s: it exists for his arrival, nothing else.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: His R dash is untargetable, so the stun cannot stop it — drop a sphere on yourself and E the moment he appears behind you. A stunned, marked Zed eats your full combo before the 3s detonation.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: With E on its 15s cooldown you have no answer to a W-swap re-engage — the kill you chased becomes his Death Mark reset. Take the trade you won and step back behind the wave.
